clips.title: The story
paras: Mor'Ladim is a dangerous, vengeful skeletal warrior wandering the grounds of Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. Formerly the noble knight Morgan Ladimore, he succumbed to profound grief and madness upon discovering the loss of his family, rising in undeath to slaughter anyone crossing his path.

Before he became the terror of Raven Hill, Mor'Ladim lived as Morgan Ladimore, a devoted knight and defender of the helpless from Grand Hamlet—the town now known as Darkshire. Married at eighteen to his wife Lys, he raised three children in peace until war summoned him north. Morgan marched alongside Uther the Lightbringer to Lordaeron during the Third War, witnessing the downfall of the Knights of the Silver Hand, the spread of Kel'Thuzad's plague, and the tragic death of Uther himself.
